versions.changelog:
Initial release of the 三维技术面信号引擎 (technical-indicator-signal-engine):

- Combines trend (EMA13/55 + ADX14), mean reversion (Bollinger Bands 20,±2), and volume-price (OBV + volume ratio) indicators for comprehensive buy/sell/hold signals.
- Uses a three-factor voting system to avoid reliance on a single indicator.
- Provides a simple trigger phrase: “分析 XXXX” for signal analysis on any OHLCV data.
- Fully implemented with pandas, compatible with any equity, ETF, or crypto asset.
- Outputs clear signals: 1 (buy), -1 (sell), or 0 (hold), based on confluence across three dimensions.
